state_rule: A capability advances only when evidence for the named stage exists. An adapter or tool schema alone is CONTRACT_ONLY.
legacy_rule: The 4B v2 pilot is historical evidence and never advances a 9B v3 capability state.

capabilities.name: Direct answer / tool abstention
capabilities.training_target: Answer directly when tools add no value; abstain or continue gathering evidence when the request is unsupported.

capabilities.name: Tool routing
capabilities.training_target: Choose among function, RAG, Web and Memory tools without a task-specific router or tool suffix.

capabilities.name: Function calling
capabilities.training_target: Reach valid end states with correct schemas and arguments while accepting multiple legal call sequences.

capabilities.name: RAG search / read
capabilities.training_target: Search and read a frozen StudyHub Hybrid RAG snapshot, then stop when evidence is sufficient.

capabilities.name: Query rewrite / backtracking
capabilities.training_target: Revise a failed or ambiguous query using new evidence rather than repeating the same search.

capabilities.name: Multi-hop retrieval
capabilities.training_target: Combine evidence across documents and hops without exposing oracle evidence or a gold source order.

capabilities.name: Citation and claim grounding
capabilities.training_target: Map each material claim to a supporting passage and avoid unsupported or decorative citations.

capabilities.name: Insufficient evidence
capabilities.training_target: Distinguish answerable, searchable and unanswerable requests and express calibrated uncertainty.

capabilities.name: Web search / fetch
capabilities.training_target: Use record/replay Web search and fetch for current information with source-quality checks.

capabilities.name: RAG to Web fallback
capabilities.training_target: Fall back to Web only when internal material is absent, stale or insufficient, and retain provenance boundaries.

capabilities.name: Personal Memory
capabilities.training_target: Recall useful preferences and learning state while ignoring stale, irrelevant or disallowed memories.

capabilities.name: Collective Memory
capabilities.training_target: Use aggregate learning patterns only when confidence and cohort applicability are adequate.

capabilities.name: RAG + Memory
capabilities.training_target: Combine course evidence with personal learning context without allowing memory to override source facts.

capabilities.name: Web + Memory
capabilities.training_target: Combine current Web facts with stable preferences while detecting stale memory conflicts.

capabilities.name: Permission-aware recovery
capabilities.training_target: Recover safely from denied access without probing paid, private or cross-user content.

capabilities.name: Tool failure recovery
capabilities.training_target: Recover from timeout, empty result, malformed response and transient provider failure.

capabilities.name: Conflict resolution
capabilities.training_target: Detect source or memory conflicts, prefer stronger evidence and communicate unresolved uncertainty.

capabilities.name: Long horizon
capabilities.training_target: Complete tasks requiring 8 to 20 or more policy actions while retaining state and avoiding loops.

capabilities.name: Deep research
capabilities.training_target: Produce a multi-source, evidence-grounded synthesis through the Hermes loop without a fixed research graph.

capabilities.name: Stop / cost control
capabilities.training_target: Stop after sufficient evidence, continue when useful evidence is missing, and minimize redundant actions.
